summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing weekly share repurchases under its EUR 1 billion buyback programme announced on 17 February 2026. From 10-14 August 2026, the company purchased 155,000 ordinary shares on US venues and 62,456 on London venues, all through Goldman Sachs entities, with prices ranging from USD 104.60 to USD 108.16 and GBP 77.45 to GBP 79.70. Repurchased shares will be cancelled. The programme reflects ongoing capital returns to shareholders. What to watch: pace of buyback execution and potential for programme expansion or completion timing.
